args.old:
theorem myRev_append (xs ys : List α) : myRev (xs ++ ys) = myRev ys ++ myRev xs := by
  sorry
args.new:
theorem myRev_append (xs ys : List α) : myRev (xs ++ ys) = myRev ys ++ myRev xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    simp [myRev, List.nil_append]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp [myRev, List.cons_append, ih]
